name: 原初·剑·T1·武器
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / equipment redesign.
Asset type: ONE standalone transparent production game equipment icon, gear-primal-sword-t1-weapon.
Input images: old library image supplies item identity only and MUST be redesigned. The simple sword and coat images are positive references for the current rounded chibi hand-drawn style. The game screenshot supplies the chibi character proportions and broad colour planes only; do not draw characters, scenery or UI.
Subject: one complete broad straight sword with a clearly separate short crossguard and leather grip.
Family identity across all six pieces: balanced straight edges, symmetrical V/chevron forms.
Family palette: slate steel, muted blue, brass and brown leather.
Series: PRIMAL -- warm ivory bone, bent dark wood/root, matte mineral/amber accents and woven leather/cloth; equipment has a naturally grown curved construction: smooth curved bone/wood pieces form the working body, open branching or curled joints and organic asymmetry. It must have a distinctly organic outer silhouette, not regular gear with two twigs pasted on it; no skull face, gore, aura or ornamental thorn clutter. The three series must be visibly different in their outer contour and material construction, even in greyscale.
Stage: T1 BASIC: one uncomplicated main structural layer; modest single fitting. Keep a plain compact contour with a short/simple guard or support. Armour has a simple vest/robe body, small shoulders; helmet has a low/simple crown; boots have simple cuffs; jewellery has one small readable mount.
Style: soft warm charcoal/brown outline, chunky rounded object proportions, matte hand-drawn colour blocks, TWO or THREE large shading planes, warm restrained highlights. Keep details broad and legible. Match the new simple chibi items, not the skinny ornate old library.
Composition: diagonal lower-left grip to upper-right functional end, complete and not cropped. Centred on a square transparent canvas, full object visible, longest visible extent roughly 78–82% of canvas, generous equal safety margin. Do not enlarge T3 beyond the common size.
At 32px the equipment part must read immediately; at 48px the family, series and stage must be recognisable by structure. Each icon depicts a coherent physical wearable or weapon, not a pasted symbol.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha; ONE isolated object (a pair only for boots). No background, floor, external cast shadow, frames, labels, text, numbers, rarity tags, characters, particles, glowing discs, tiny filigree or dense shiny rendering. Do not generate a sprite sheet or collage. The output is one production PNG.
normalization: alpha crop and proportional Lanczos inside 208px, centred on transparent 256px canvas
review: Use a visibly bone/wood working body to match the new strongly separated series; remove the steel-looking blade centre.
